nodes.label: message_recipients table

nodes.rationale: Exactly one of to_role_id/to_group_id; role targets include holders through a group

nodes.label: is_message_sender / is_message_recipient helpers

nodes.label: Three layers: frontend, backend, database
nodes.rationale: SQL first, backend for the edge, frontend for the user. Authorization always lives in the database (RLS); other layers only mirror it.

nodes.label: candidate_skills table
nodes.rationale: Evidence short phrase, never contact data

nodes.label: candidates table
nodes.rationale: No consent, no row; cv_path nulled after parsing

nodes.label: Fractional-indexing positions (collate C)
nodes.rationale: Fractional keys so a move writes one row; DB column position text collate C so Postgres sorts like JavaScript string comparison.

nodes.label: Notification-first PWA decision
nodes.rationale: No next-pwa plugin: service worker only handles push, so ~40 lines beat a plugin. Push is free, keeping email volume and Resend quota low.

nodes.label: Permission-filtered navigation (visibleNav)
nodes.rationale: Hiding a menu item is cosmetic; RLS is the real guard.

nodes.label: Development agents vs product AI
nodes.rationale: Development agents (Claude Code, Hermes) work on the repo; product AI (assistant, digest, CV parser) runs inside the app.

nodes.label: Agent history entry JSON contract (schema.json)
nodes.rationale: Task list says what should happen, git says which lines changed; neither records intent, verification and decisions. additionalProperties false so drift fails validation.

nodes.label: Agent history vs agent memory
nodes.rationale: History is reviewed, schema-validated and shared via git; memory is unreviewed hints and cannot override the contract.

nodes.label: One file per session, append-only entries
nodes.norm_label: one file per session, append-only entries
nodes.rationale: Per-session files avoid merge conflicts across parallel branches and agents; corrections via supersedes.

nodes.label: graphify-out/ engine output
nodes.rationale: Not renamed because graphify git hooks, Claude Code hook and always-on rules point at repo-root graphify-out/; renaming breaks graph-first navigation.

nodes.label: .graphifyignore indexing scope
nodes.rationale: Excludes deps, generated files and vendored UI primitives so graph stays about the domain.

nodes.label: calendar_feed_tokens (ICS feed, PSI-044)
nodes.rationale: One secret token per user; ICS route has no JWT

nodes.label: events_for_user()
nodes.rationale: Same visibility as can_see_event by explicit user id

nodes.label: events table
nodes.rationale: source separates app from google events; imported events have no app owner so cannot be edited in app

nodes.label: notify_event_invites trigger
nodes.rationale: One notification batch per insert statement; imported Google events never notify; re-notification on later audience add accepted in v1

nodes.label: document_views (view log)
nodes.rationale: Accountability for sensitive folders

nodes.label: drive_files (Drive mirror)
nodes.rationale: Only google-drive/sync via service role writes

nodes.label: queue_google_push triggers (pg_net)
nodes.rationale: Async push after commit; BEFORE DELETE captures links before cascade

nodes.label: agent_* security_invoker views
nodes.rationale: security_invoker=true so caller RLS applies; otherwise view leaks as owner

nodes.label: useChat + /api/chat
nodes.rationale: CHAT_MODEL chosen server-side; UI never changes with it

nodes.label: One-way rule (sources to obsidian-out, read-only)
nodes.rationale: Letting Kanban plugin write back would create a second writer rewriting the whole task file on every drag and cause merge conflicts with agent branches.

nodes.label: boards table
nodes.rationale: Shared with users and/or groups

nodes.label: notify_task_assignee trigger
nodes.rationale: Never notify on self-assignment

nodes.label: activity_log table
nodes.rationale: Trigger-fed read model; summary has no personal data; visibility follows entity visibility

nodes.label: activity-retention cron (180 days)
nodes.rationale: Keep free-tier DB small

nodes.label: Fractional position ordering (collate C)
nodes.rationale: position text collate C = JS string order; a move writes one row
